Following that, ensure that the gate inside the spare room is open. And then, take a trip west. Then, open the passageway in the canteen. Once you have pulled open the passageway, go west. Then, attempt to head north. Once you finish that, take a trip west. And then, try to go to the north. With that done, venture west. And then, go to the north. With that over with, move north. Following that, make an attempt to venture east. Then, recover the key from the floor of the playroom. Alright, thanks!
